    Plot circular cell-phase density by sampling time

    plot_phase_flower.Rd

    This function plots circular density summaries of inferred cell phases across sampling Zeitgeber time groups. Cells are matched between res_phase and metadata by the cell column.

    plot_phase_flower(
  res_phase,
  metadata,
  zt_by = "ZT",
  group_by = "celltype",
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  group_levels = NULL,
  zt_levels = NULL,
  zt_colors = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    res_phase

    A data.frame returned by infer_cell_phase().

    metadata

    A data.frame containing cell-level metadata.

    zt_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata that contains sampling Zeitgeber time in hours. Defaults to "ZT".

    group_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata used for faceting. If NULL, all cells are plotted in one panel. Defaults to "celltype".

    theta_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in res_phase that contains inferred cell phase in radians. Defaults to "theta_pred".

    group_levels

    A character vector specifying the order of facet groups. If NULL, groups are sorted automatically. Defaults to NULL.

    zt_levels

    A numeric vector specifying the order of ZT groups. If NULL, ZT levels are sorted automatically. Defaults to NULL.

    zt_colors

    A named character vector specifying colors for ZT groups. Names can be formatted ZT labels, such as "ZT00" and "ZT04", or numeric hour labels, such as "0" and "4". If NULL, the default scRhythmBayes phase palette is used. Defaults to NULL.

    title

    A character vector specifying the plot title. If NULL, a default title is used. Defaults to NULL.

    Verbose

    A logical value indicating whether progress messages should be printed. Defaults to FALSE.

    Value

    Invisibly returns a list containing:

    plot

    A ggplot object.

    data

    The processed cell-level plotting data.

    density

    The circular density data.

    ring

    The ZT ring annotation data.

    cell_count

    Cell-count summary by group.

    params

    Plotting parameters.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

p_flower <- plot_phase_flower(
  res_phase = res_phase,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  zt_by = "ZT",
  group_by = "celltype"
)

p_flower$plot
} # }
